summary.replayMethod: Invoke the exact already-compiled failed test methods, frozen locally, against task/before and current source roots using a standalone Java reflection harness. Test sources are byte-identical to baseline. No Gradle, Android device, old-toolchain build, production source edit or assertion relaxation.
summary.limitation: This proves these exact text/directory assertions also fail on the captured pre-upgrade tree. It does not prove the old full suite, historical runtime behavior, or any methods beyond the first failed assertion.

failures.diagnosis: Settings routing source lacks the asserted R.string.color_scheme literal; earlier ColorSchemeSelectionScreen and CustomColorSettingsScreen assertions pass. app/build.gradle changed, but is not the operand of the failing assertion.

The assertion forbids OneDrive creation, but the pre-upgrade Activity already contains its route. This is an old test expectation versus implemented surface mismatch, not proof of a runtime MDBX failure.

The substringAfter delimiter contains LF, but the checked file has CRLF. The delimiter is absent, so Kotlin substringAfter returns the whole source; substringBefore then captures an earlier selected-source overload and the forbidden when expression. This does not demonstrate that the explicit-origin overload selects the wrong source.

The guard pins alpha18 literally; baseline and current catalog both have material3Expressive 1.5.0-rc01. The catalog has other changes this round, so whole-file identity cannot be claimed; the failed version predicate is identical.

The literal expects LF between Scaffold and modifier; baseline/current PaymentScreen has CRLF. The actual modifier assignment is present. This text failure does not establish a missing dock-safe modifier at runtime.
The guard requires an appSupportScrollState variable no longer present in the pre-upgrade settings router. No functional scroll-state conclusion is drawn from this name-based guard.

The guard literally expects 1.0.309; baseline/current app version is 1.0.310 and code18. The build script changed elsewhere this round, but this version predicate was already false. Five resource paths are constructed before failure but their readText calls occur after the failed assertion and are not reached.
